title: Bridging the Horizon: online brokerage for Cancer Mission 2027 calls
organiser: UK Health National Contact Points and the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT)
summary: An online partner-search event built around the five Cancer Mission topics in the Horizon Europe 2026-2027 work programme.
details: The session is aimed at organisations putting together consortia for the 2027 Cancer Mission calls.
Applications to take part close on 13 December 2026.
why: Cancer Mission topics reward broad consortia that join clinical, research and industry partners, and these are hard to assemble late. Applicants who already know which topic they are targeting should use the event to fill specific gaps rather than to browse.
